annotations.text:
Your Waypoint design, rebuilt from its source values — Inter, teal oklch(62% 0.15 200) / violet oklch(60% 0.17 280), same radii, spacing and copy.
Only one thing changed: the spaces rail is now a grid. Everything else is left exactly as you had it.
No fake iOS status bar or home indicator drawn — on a real phone the OS paints those over your layout.
Three grid treatments with their real height cost, so the choice is made on numbers rather than taste.
